seo.title: Free Online Sudoku Game - Puzzle Garden
seo.description: The classic brain puzzle: fill a 9×9 grid with the numbers 1-9! Play free Sudoku in a range of difficulties, from easy to hard.
seo.summary: What is Sudoku? - Free Online Sudoku Game
seo.p1: Sudoku is a logic puzzle where you fill a 9×9 grid with numbers. Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once. No math skills needed - just pure logic and focus, which is why it's loved around the world as a brain puzzle game.
seo.p2: Tap an empty cell and enter a number from 1 to 9 that fits. A number that already appears in the same row, column, or box can't be used again. If you get stuck, the hint feature can help. If you're new, start with Beginner Sudoku or an easy difficulty.
seo.p3:
Beginner · Easy - for people new to Sudoku. Plenty of clues are given.
Medium - try it once you know the basic rules. Some logical deduction is required.
Hard · Time Attack - a speed challenge where you finish within a time limit. Made for experts.
seo.p4: Sudoku is great for improving focus, logical thinking, and short-term memory. Studies suggest that solving for 10-15 minutes a day may help keep your mind sharp. Give your brain a daily workout with free online Sudoku on Puzzle Garden.

q1.a: Sudoku is a logic puzzle where you fill a 9×9 grid with the numbers 1 through 9. No number can appear twice in any row, column, or 3×3 box. It's a brain game that relies on pure logic, not math.

q2.a: Yes, Sudoku on Puzzle Garden is completely free. You can start playing right away without signing up, with difficulties ranging from beginner to hard.

q3.q: Which difficulty should a beginner start with?
q3.a: If you're new, we recommend Beginner mode. The difficulty rises step by step so you can build your skills gradually. Once you're comfortable, try Time Attack mode.

q4.q: Is Sudoku good for the brain?
q4.a: Yes. Sudoku helps improve focus, logical thinking, and short-term memory. Solving for 10-15 minutes a day is thought to help keep your mind sharp.
